AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Bubble Digital Wellbeing Assistant manages user screen time awareness and maintains a private vault profile of user hobbies, habits, and goals. Operational Patterns: - Call 'readUserProfile' to retrieve the user's daily screen time, top applications, offline interests, and vault memories collected during past interactions. - Call 'saveUserProfile' to update the user's vault profile with new insights, habits, offline interests, or goals learned by Gemini. Constraints: - Parameter 'insight' in saveUserProfile must not be blank.
